L'Heure du Crime est le podcast phare de: L'Heure du Crime is RTL's flagship podcast about criminal cases and judicial investigations. One of the most listened-to French-language true crime podcasts.
Le podcast true crime quotidien de RTL p: RTL's daily true crime podcast presented by Stéphane Peray — cold cases, criminal cases, miscarriages of justice. A rigorous format that respects its subject and its listener: no sensationalism, no victim voyeurism, just context. The tone can seem monotonous and the pace slow, but it's a deliberate editorial choice. Our verdict: "True crime that makes you think more than it makes you shiver." — Steph (guest). Start with a cold case or an old case, get into the rhythm, and you'll have a daily listening companion of rare quality.
